description: This file defines the RequestException class within the GuzzleHttp library, representing HTTP request exceptions, including methods for creating, wrapping, and retrieving exception details.

classes.name: RequestException
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request exception, providing methods to create, wrap, and access request and response details.

methods.name: wrapException
methods.description: Wraps a generic Throwable into a RequestException if it isn't already one.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new RequestException with a normalized error message based on the response status.

methods.name: obfuscateUri
methods.description: Obfuscates the URI if it contains user info with a password.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the request that caused the exception.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the response associated with the exception, if any.

methods.name: hasResponse
methods.description: Checks if a response was received.

methods.name: getHandlerContext
methods.description: Returns contextual information about the error from the handler.
